topic: The Logic of Abstract Vector Spaces

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: From Arrows to Rules
lecture_lines: Vectors are arrows with length and direction.
animations: Create a 2D arrow (length 2, direction 45deg) at center with color #FF5733.
Animate vector stretching to length 3 and rotating to 60deg; change color to #33FF57.
Transition the vector into a static Dot at coordinate (2, 3) using color #3357FF.

sections.title: The Generalization Leap
lecture_lines: A vector space is a collection of objects.
animations: Display a vector Arrow icon at center, color #FF5733.
Morph the Arrow icon into a smooth Function curve symbol f(x), color #33FF57.
Morph the Function symbol into a standard quadratic Polynomial expression, ax²+bx+c, color #3357FF.

sections.title: Application: The Library of Sounds
lecture_lines: Each time point is a dimension.
Adding clips creates a new sound.
animations: Draw a continuous audio wave signal representing a single vector line, color #FF5733.
Display two distinct signal vector waveforms labeled 'Bass' (color #33FF57) and 'Treble' (color #3357FF).
Animate the vector sum of Bass and Treble, resulting in a complex superimposed waveform vector, color #FF33FF.

sections.title: Core Constraints: The Axiomatic DNA
lecture_lines: Spaces must pass the stress test.
Closure requires staying within the set.
Sum of vectors must be inside.
animations: Display a container shape titled 'Set' holding diverse polynomial expressions, color #FF5733.
Perform an addition of two polynomials within the container; animate container glowing green if result stays inside, color #33FF57.
Perform an invalid addition that leaves the set; animate container flashing red, color #FF3333.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Power of Abstraction
lecture_lines: Data points obey these same rules.
animations: Display a single central Arrow vector, color #FF5733.
Animate a rapid camera zoom-out revealing a dense, sprawling cloud of data points, color #3357FF.
Fade in a geometric lattice grid overlay that connects the data points, showing a unified structure, color #FFFFFF.
